_about: ElevenLabs sound-effect spec for Ghost Duels: one entry per file in ghost-duels-web/assets/sfx. 'use' is how game.js plays it (sound module, use(...) calls), 'gen' is the request, 'judge' the measurable bar a take must clear. See README.md in this folder.

defaults.key: A minor (game scale: A Phrygian; music: Spooky Carousel, A minor, ~96 BPM); wins resolve to A major
defaults.style: Playful-spooky pirate ghost crypt (direction v3, README.md): hand-made and organic - old wood, bone, iron chains, brass, glass and crystal, soft pipe organ, a distant ghost choir, green spectral shimmer. Cartoon-gothic, never horror: no screams, no harsh noise. One room for everything: a small torch-lit stone crypt, short dark reverb (about 1 s). Musical parts on A (A minor; wins resolve to A major). No sub rumble, no piercing highs, soft attacks on frequent sounds. The tool sends prompts as written, so every prompt carries this palette itself.

sounds.name: click
sounds.role: Any button press (bet +/-, menus, autoplay, info).

prompts: Tiny UI click: an instant sharp tap of a brass compass lid snapping shut with a faint wooden tick. A hard transient at the very first millisecond, extremely short, dry, no fade-in, no reverb, no tail.

Tiny UI click: an instant sharp tap of a brass compass lid snapping shut with a faint wooden tick. A hard transient at the very first millisecond, extremely short, dry, no fade-in, no reverb, no tail.

sounds.name: spin
sounds.role: Spin pressed: the old board falls out before the new symbols drop. Every round, thousands of times.

prompts: Slot spin start for a playful-spooky pirate ghost game: an instant soft wooden thud, then a quick downward whoosh as old bone and wooden tiles tumble away, the creak of a ship's wheel and a faint green spectral swirl. Warm, tight, not bright, short, organic, cartoon-gothic.

Spin start in a haunted pirate crypt: an instant muffled thump of a wooden crate, a short airy whoosh falling downward and a soft rattle of bones and chain. Warm, round, short, not harsh, made to repeat thousands of times.

Clean, minimal slot spin: a single soft wooden click at the very first moment, then one smooth airy whoosh sweeping downward. Crisp and clear, no rattles, no crackle, no rumble, nothing muddy, about half a second, dry with a tiny stone-room reverb.

Clean spin start for a pirate ghost slot game: one crisp, light swish like a ship's sail snapping, with a tiny wooden tick on top. Simple, clear, airy, no low boom, no noise, very short, gentle enough to repeat thousands of times.

judge.note: not too bright: it repeats every spin

sounds.name: land
sounds.role: A reel comes to rest. 7 per spin, faster in turbo; the game raises it a little per reel.

prompts: One single clean wooden 'tock': a soft, round knock of a small wooden block, one hit only, no second click, no rattle, no noise. Warm mid-range, slightly tonal like a woodblock, very short, dry, starts instantly. A slot symbol settling into place.

A slot symbol landing: one soft, rounded knock of a wooden chest lid closing gently, a single clean hit with a warm hollow body. No clicks, no rattles, no crackle, very short, dry, starts instantly, pleasant to hear seven times in a row.
One muted wooden tap like a soft marimba bar hit with a felt mallet: a single clean, round, warm knock, very short, dry, starts instantly. Nothing else, no click, no noise.

judge.note: clean: one round knock, no second click (v3 round 2); needs mid-range, phone speakers drop the low thud

sounds.name: land_heavy
sounds.role: A VS reel or a ghost crate slams down (also under every crate landing in the bonus).

gen.prompt: A heavy iron-bound treasure chest dropping onto crypt stone: an instant deep wooden thud with a short iron chain rattle and a small puff of green spectral sparks. Punchy, warm, short, small stone room reverb, cartoon-gothic not horror.

sounds.name: chime
sounds.role: Win arpeggios, small duel win.
sounds.note: Pitched note source: the game plays it as A5 and transposes it into the win arpeggios (2-5 notes, scale steps) and the small duel sting. apply retunes the take to the nearest A, so it must be one clear note.

prompts: One single clear glass bell note, pitch A5, soft attack, warm and round with a gentle ghostly shimmer in the tail, small stone room reverb. One note only, no melody, clean.
One single note on an old music box, pitch A5: a pure, warm ringing tone with a faint airy shimmer in the tail. One note only, no melody, clean, gentle.
One single celesta note, pitch A5: soft, round and magical, a short natural ring-out in a small stone room. One note only, no melody, clean.

sounds.name: crystal
sounds.keep: Pitched note source (A5) for runes landing and being collected, stepped up the scale per rune. Same reason as chime.
sounds.role: Bonus: rune lands, rune collected.

sounds.name: tumble
sounds.role: Winning symbols vanish (every cascade step).

prompts: Winning symbols dissolving into green ghost dust: an instant soft pop, a sandy sparkling whoosh and a tiny glass shimmer. Playful-spooky pirate ghost slot game, warm, short, satisfying, not harsh.
Winning tiles crumbling like old bone and wood into spectral dust: an instant soft crunch with a bright little sparkle tail. Short, satisfying, gentle, cartoon-gothic.

sounds.name: charge
sounds.role: The small VS symbol charges up, right before it bursts into a VS reel.

prompts: Fighting game power-up charge: a fast rising electric energy whine over a deep bass swell, building for one second with crackling sparks and a rush of wind, cut off sharply at its loudest. Intense, punchy arcade fighting game, no voices.

Arcade fighter charging a special move: a reversed cymbal and a rising synth riser surging from silence to a full peak in one second, electric crackle on top, ending abruptly at its loudest. Tense and powerful, no voices.

judge.note: must end at its loudest, the burst follows

sounds.name: burst
sounds.role: The VS reel bursts open. Also reused, slightly higher (rate 1.15), as the slam that starts a duel.

prompts: Fighting game VS screen impact: an instant massive punchy boom with a sharp metallic sword shing on top, a shockwave whoosh and a short big-hall reverb tail. Epic, aggressive, arcade versus screen, no voices.
Arcade fighter versus slam: an instant heavy bass-drop hit with a cymbal crash and a crackle of electric energy, a short big-hall tail. Powerful and exciting, no voices, no music.

sounds.name: clash
sounds.role: Two duel fighters collide: a fighting-game sword and punch impact; harder and lower the higher the stakes.

prompts: Two swords clashing hard in a fighting game: an instant bright steel-on-steel shing with a heavy body-punch impact underneath and a short whoosh, punchy and dry with a short tail. Aggressive, satisfying hit, no voices.
Fighting game heavy hit: a meaty punch impact and a metallic cutlass clang with sparks at the same instant, a short whoosh and a tight tail. Intense arcade combat, no voices.

sounds.name: wail
sounds.role: A duel fighter is knocked out (the other one wins the round): a fighting-game K.O. hit (the file keeps its old name).

prompts: Fighting game knockout: an instant huge final punch impact with a deep slow-motion boom and a sword shattering, a short rushing whoosh fading away, short dark tail. Decisive K.O. moment, epic, not comic, no voices.
K.O. finishing blow in an arcade fighting game: an instant crushing hit with a bass drop and a glassy shatter, then a slow-motion whoosh trailing off. Heavy and final, not funny, no voices.

sounds.name: toll
sounds.role: Deep bell toll. Also played an octave up (rate 2) under character wins and crate landings.
sounds.pitched: A2 (110 Hz): retune the chosen take to exactly A2; reject takes more than 1 semitone off or with more than one strike

gen.prompt: A single deep haunted church bell toll, one strike only, note A2, long ringing decay with a dark cathedral reverb. Powerful, ominous, majestic, high-quality professional recording.

sounds.keep: ElevenLabs ignored the note (2 takes came out around E, 5 semitones off); the designed toll is exactly A2, which the game needs because it also plays it an octave up under wins.

sounds.name: sting
sounds.role: Duel won by the pirate (tier 2 multipliers x20-x100): the music dips under it.

prompts: Victory sting with root note A, in A major: an instant brass hit on an A major chord, a celesta arpeggio A, C sharp, E, A, a warm ghost choir 'ahh' on A major and a sprinkle of coins. Triumphant, playful, short, clean.

Short win sting in A major, root note A: an instant bright bell on A, a music box run up the A major chord and a warm accordion and choir chord of A major, coins sparkling. Joyful, cartoon-gothic, clean.

sounds.name: sting_devil
sounds.role: The devil wins a duel (x150-x1000), the devil enters as challenger (rate 0.92), and the layer on top of the max win.

prompts: The devil arrives: an instant low brass and pipe organ sting in A minor, a deep ominous gong and a mischievous breathy chuckle (no words), short dark crypt tail. Big and dramatic but cartoon-gothic, fun, not horror.

Devilish jackpot sting: an instant warm brass-and-choir hit in A minor, a deep organ pedal, a rolling timpani and a sly laugh made of breath (no words). Dramatic, exciting, playful-spooky, no screams.

sounds.name: fanfare
sounds.role: Free spins (Ghost Crates bonus) triggered: the music dips 2.2 s under it. (The Total Win screen has its own sound now: totalwin.)

prompts: Free spins sting with root note A, in A minor: starts instantly with a soft thunder boom, a music box and celesta run ending on a low A, a ghost choir 'ooh' on an A minor chord and one deep bell on A. Mysterious, exciting, short.

Bonus reveal in A minor, root note A: an instant creaking chest lid and soft boom, an accordion and pizzicato flourish landing on an A minor chord, a ghost choir 'ooh' and a warm low bell on A. Spooky but inviting, short.

finish._why: the chosen take has half a second of silence between the explosion and the bells

sounds.name: bigwin
sounds.role: Big win (20x bet or more): a money payout. The max win adds sting_devil on top. The music dips 3-4 s.

prompts: Big win in a haunted pirate crypt: starts instantly with a warm pipe organ and brass chord in A major, a ghost choir rising in joy, bells ringing and a cascade of gold coins pouring onto stone. Euphoric, rewarding, spooky-fun, no screams.

Pirate treasure payout: an instant chest lid flung open, a shower of gold coins on stone, an accordion and music-box fanfare in A major, a ghost choir swelling and a hearty breathy pirate laugh (no words). Joyful, cartoon-gothic.
Spooky jackpot in A major: an instant bright bell and brass hit, a celesta and pizzicato run climbing, a warm choir chord and coins spilling. Rewarding, euphoric, friendly-spooky.

sounds.name: totalwin
sounds.role: Total Win screen after the free spins (after the win tiers): a happy, warm celebration of the whole bonus. The music dips 3.5 s under it.

prompts: Happy total win celebration in a playful-spooky pirate crypt: starts instantly with a bright brass and accordion fanfare in A major, a cheerful music box and celesta melody climbing up, a joyful wordless ghost choir 'aah' on a big A major chord, sparkling bells and a shower of gold coins, ending on a warm, satisfied A major chord. Triumphant, warm and friendly, cartoon-gothic, never dark.

Victory jingle in A major for a cozy-spooky pirate ghost game: an instant cheerful accordion and pizzicato fanfare, a celesta melody rising to a happy high A, a warm brass chord with a jolly tuba, a joyful ghost choir and a soft cymbal swell with tinkling coins. Bright, celebratory, fun, short crypt reverb, no screams.

Treasure found: a happy pirate fanfare in A major, an instant brass and fiddle flourish, a music box melody bouncing upward, a glockenspiel sparkle, gold coins clinking, a warm pipe organ and ghost choir resolving to a bright A major chord. Joyful, rewarding, playful-spooky, never menacing.

finish._why: new: the Total Win played the fanfare before, so it starts at that loudness

sounds.name: heartbeat
sounds.role: Bonus: a life is lost (a spin without a hit). A small setback, so dramatic but short, never sad.

prompts: A life lost: two heartbeat knocks played as a mid-range wooden drum thump with a clear knock, bright enough for phone speakers, a soft crack of glass and a short descending airy whoosh. Dramatic but gentle, not sad, short.
Two quick knocks on a wooden coffin lid like a heartbeat, crisp mid-range, a small glass crack and a falling whisper. Clear on small speakers, short, not sad.

sounds.name: crumble
sounds.role: Bonus end: runes without a crate crumble to dust. A small loss, so understated on purpose.

gen.prompt: Old rune stones crumbling to dust: a short dry grinding crumble with falling grit and a soft low thud, quiet and understated, small stone room.

sounds.name: challenger
sounds.role: The ghost pirate enters as challenger in a duel (the music dips 1.6 s).

prompts: A new challenger enters in a fighting game: an instant dramatic brass and orchestra hit, a fast drum roll into a heavy impact and an electric energy surge, a short ominous choir chord. Intense arcade fighting game, wordless.

Fighting game challenger alert: an instant heavy impact with a metallic sword draw, a pounding taiko hit and a rising surge of dark energy, a short dramatic orchestral stab. Exciting and tense, no voices.

sounds.name: banner
sounds.role: A banner appears (round and feature announcements); the music dips 2 s.

prompts: Announcement: a soft rising gust of ghostly wind into a bright bell and celesta hit in A major with a little green sparkle. Inviting, playful-spooky, short.
A rolled parchment banner unfurling with a soft whoosh, ending on a warm music-box and bell chord in A major. Friendly, magical, short.

sounds.name: fs_land
sounds.role: An FS (scatter) symbol lands; the loudest effect, each further FS in a spin 2 semitones higher (up to an octave).
sounds.note: The current file is built from an ElevenLabs download (audio-src/Magical_scatter_symb_#4...mp3) and peaks at +0.8 dBFS (clips). Check under which plan it was generated.

prompts: Bonus symbol lands: an instant soft wooden thump with one clear magical bell note on A, celesta on the same pitch, a quick upward green sparkle and a short ring-out. Bright but warm, rewarding, musical, clean, not harsh in the highs.

Special symbol appears: an instant music box and harp pluck on one note (A) over a deep soft boom, a ghost choir 'ah' blooming for half a second and a glitter sparkle. Magical, mysterious, rewarding, clean.

judge.note: must still sound good an octave up: not too much extreme high end

finish._why: the game plays it up to an octave higher; the bright top would turn shrill

sounds.name: edge
sounds.role: Tease: one FS away, under each teasing reel (2.4 s body plus tail), a semitone higher per further reel; the music dips.

prompts: Suspense riser for a pirate ghost slot game: quiet at first and growing louder and higher for two and a half seconds, pizzicato strings speeding up, a soft heartbeat and a rising glass-harmonica shimmer, then a sudden stop and a short dark tail. Anticipation, eerie but playful.

Tension build-up: a ticking pocket watch and an accordion tremolo rising in pitch and loudness for two and a half seconds over a soft ghostly choir swell, then a sudden cut and a short crypt tail. Exciting, mysterious, cartoon-gothic.
